```{r setup}
source("report_setup.R")
# The submission rules: at most 5,000 characters, counting the title, the body and spaces; each
# image (a table counts as one) is charged up to 560, so it is charged 560 here
limit <- 5000
per_image <- 560

lower_first <- function(x) paste0(tolower(substr(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2))
# A cut label as the least it implies: "At least 4–8 times/month" -> "at least 4 times a month"
cut_floor <- function(x) {
  x <- sub("^At least (\\d+)–\\d+", "at least \\1", x)
  x <- sub("times/month", "times a month", x, fixed = TRUE)
  sub(" days$", " days a week", lower_first(x))
}
one <- function(x, what) {
  if (length(x) != 1 || is.na(x)) stop("abstract.qmd: no single value for ", what, call. = FALSE)
  x
}
# "0.88 (95% CI 0.85 to 0.90)"; inside a parenthesis already, "1.4; 95% CI 0.7 to 2.1". Results
# name "95% CI" at the first interval only (label = FALSE after it), as abstracts do
ci_text <- function(est, lo, hi, digits = 2, inner = FALSE, label = TRUE) {
  ci <- sprintf("%s%s to %s", if (label) "95% CI " else "", num(lo, digits), num(hi, digits))
  sprintf(if (inner) "%s; %s" else "%s (%s)", num(est, digits), ci)
}
and2 <- function(x) if (length(x) == 1) x[[1]] else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
# Two visits' values: one number when they print the same, else both
pair <- function(x, digits = 2) if (length(unique(num(x, digits))) == 1) num(x[1], digits) else and2(num(x, digits))
at_visits <- paste(and2(sub(" months$", "", wave(comp_visits))), "months")  # "48 and 72 months"
# A word for each visit's value; "weak to moderate" when the visits differ
ladder <- function(x, cuts, words) {
  w <- unique(words[findInterval(x, cuts, left.open = TRUE) + 1])
  if (length(w) == 1) w else paste(w[1], "to", w[length(w)])
}

metric <- function(key) one(run$metrics[[key]], key)
n_val <- metric("sample.validation.persons")
n_walk <- metric("sample.validation.walkers")
n_dev <- metric("sample.validation.device_walkers")
cls_ci <- function(m) ci_text(one(pick("validation", m), m), one(pick("validation", m, "lo"), m), one(pick("validation", m, "hi"), m), label = FALSE)
j_item <- one(youden("validation"), "Youden's J")
kg <- run$validity_known_groups[run$validity_known_groups$sample == "validation", ]
kg_row <- function(m) {
  r <- kg[kg$measure == m, ]
  if (nrow(r) != 1) stop("abstract.qmd: no single known-groups row for ", m, call. = FALSE)
  r
}
item_cuts <- cut_names("times")
pase_cuts <- cut_names("pase")
item_get <- function(k, stat, col = "estimate") one(ci_get("validation", "times", k, stat, col), paste("item", k, stat, col))
pase_get <- function(v, k, col = "estimate") one(cp_get(v, "frequency", "device_walker", k, "j", col), paste("PASE J", v, k, col))
weekly <- function(v, level, stat) one(cp_get(v, "weekly", "purposeful_week", level, stat), paste("PASE weekly", v, stat))
guide <- assumption("reference.min_bout_minutes_per_week")
```

```{r text}
title <- "DOES A SELF-REPORTED WALKING-FOR-EXERCISE QUESTION AGREE WITH ACCELEROMETRY? A VALIDATION STUDY IN THE OSTEOARTHRITIS INITIATIVE"

purpose <- "In the Osteoarthritis Initiative, a question about walking for exercise since age 50 has been linked to fewer people developing frequent knee pain but, to our knowledge, has not been compared with a device measure. We assessed how well it, and the walking items of the Physical Activity Scale for the Elderly (PASE), agree with accelerometry."

walker_short <- switch(yes_without,
  `non-walker` = "answered yes and said how much they walk",
  walker = "answered yes",
  exclude = "answered yes and said how much they walk (a yes with no amount was left out)",
  stop("unknown exposure.yes_without_amount_as: ", yes_without, call. = FALSE))
device_at <- if (combination == "mean") sprintf("%s (averaged when both were valid)", waves_at) else waves_at
# The frequency definitions leave out walkers who gave no times-a-month answer
n_freq <- item_get("cut1", "se", "n") + item_get("cut1", "sp", "n")
freq_left_out <- n_val - n_freq
pase_against <- if (comp_paired) "against the device at the same visit" else sprintf("against %s", combined_text)
methods <- paste0(
  sprintf("Participants answered the walking question at the 96-month visit and had accelerometer data (ActiGraph GT1M) at %s; a valid day had at least %s wear hours, and a usable visit at least %s valid days. ",
          device_at, fmt(assumption("device.valid_day_hours")), fmt(assumption("device.min_valid_days"))),
  sprintf("Walkers %s. A device-defined walker showed %s (%s counts a minute or more). ", walker_short, rule_plain, fmt(cutpoint)),
  sprintf("We compared device activity between walkers and non-walkers (Hodges–Lehmann differences) and estimated sensitivity, specificity and Youden's J against the device-defined walker, for any walking and for stricter definitions by times a month (walkers below the cut counted as non-walkers%s). ",
          if (freq_left_out > 0) sprintf("; %s without a frequency left out", count(freq_left_out)) else ""),
  sprintf("PASE days of walking outside the home in the past week were assessed the same way, %s, and PASE weekly minutes were compared with device minutes in bouts (Spearman correlation; kappa at %s minutes a week).",
          pase_against, fmt(guide)))

# Known groups: say only what each interval shows
bout <- kg_row("purposeful_min"); counts <- kg_row("counts_per_day"); light <- kg_row("light_min")
more <- function(r) !is.na(r$hl_lo) & r$hl_lo > 0
kg_verb <- function(r) {
  if (more(r)) "more" else if (!is.na(r$hl_hi) & r$hl_hi < 0) "fewer" else if (r$hl >= 0) "not clearly more" else "not clearly fewer"
}
kg_ci <- function(r, digits, lead = "", label = FALSE) sprintf("(%s%s)", lead, ci_text(r$hl, r$hl_lo, r$hl_hi, digits, inner = TRUE, label = label))
kg_sentence <- sprintf("Walkers recorded %s minutes a day in bouts of %s+ minutes %s, %s activity counts a day %s and %s light-activity minutes %s.",
                       kg_verb(bout), purposeful_minutes, kg_ci(bout, 1, "difference ", label = TRUE),
                       kg_verb(counts), kg_ci(counts, 0), kg_verb(light), kg_ci(light, 1))
# Frequency: J for any walking and the stricter cuts (walkers below a cut count as non-walkers)
j_cuts <- vapply(names(item_cuts), item_get, numeric(1), stat = "j")
j_rises <- all(diff(j_cuts) > 0)
j_cut_ci <- function(k) ci_text(j_cuts[[k]], item_get(k, "j", "lo"), item_get(k, "j", "hi"), label = FALSE)
# "at least 4, or 9 or more, times a month" when both cuts share the unit
cuts_text <- function(a, b, unit = " times a month") {
  if (endsWith(a, unit) && endsWith(b, unit)) sprintf("%s, or %s,%s", sub(unit, "", a, fixed = TRUE), sub(unit, "", b, fixed = TRUE), unit) else sprintf("%s, or %s,", a, b)
}
freq_sentence <- sprintf("Requiring walking %s %s J to %s and %s.",
                         cuts_text(cut_floor(item_cuts[["cut2"]]), cut_floor(item_cuts[["cut3"]])),
                         if (j_rises) "raised" else "changed", j_cut_ci("cut2"), j_cut_ci("cut3"))
# How well J separates walkers, in bands: below 0.3 poorly, below 0.5 moderately, else well
j_band <- function(j) ladder(j, c(0.3, 0.5), c("poorly", "moderately", "well"))
separates <- j_band(j_item)
# PASE's any-walking J (each visit) in the same band as the question's J
pase_any <- vapply(comp_visits, pase_get, numeric(1), k = "cut1")
pase_mid <- vapply(comp_visits, pase_get, numeric(1), k = "cut2")
pase_like <- j_band(pase_any) == separates
pase_sentence <- sprintf("PASE separated device-defined walkers %s%s: J %s for any walking at %s, and %s for %s.",
                         j_band(pase_any), if (pase_like) " too" else "", pair(pase_any), at_visits,
                         pair(pase_mid), cut_floor(pase_cuts[["cut2"]]))
rho <- vapply(comp_visits, weekly, numeric(1), level = "all", stat = "rho")
kappa <- vapply(comp_visits, weekly, numeric(1), level = "guideline", stat = "kappa")
diff_min <- vapply(comp_visits, weekly, numeric(1), level = "all", stat = "median_diff")
rho_word <- ladder(rho, c(0.3, 0.5), c("weakly", "moderately", "strongly"))
# Landis and Koch's bands for kappa
kappa_word <- ladder(kappa, c(-Inf, 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8), c("poor", "poor", "slight", "fair", "moderate", "substantial", "almost perfect"))
both <- if (length(unique(num(diff_min, 0))) == 1) " at both visits" else ""
gap <- if (all(diff_min > 0)) sprintf("exceeded them by a median of %s minutes a week%s", pair(diff_min, 0), both) else
  sprintf("differed from them by a median of %s minutes a week%s", pair(diff_min, 0), both)
weekly_sentence <- sprintf("PASE weekly minutes correlated %s with device minutes in bouts (Spearman ρ %s), %s, and showed %s agreement on reaching %s minutes a week (kappa %s).",
                           rho_word, pair(rho), gap, kappa_word, fmt(guide), pair(kappa))
results <- paste(
  sprintf("Of %s participants, %s (%s) were walkers by the question and %s (%s) by the device.", count(n_val), count(n_walk), pct(n_walk / n_val), count(n_dev), pct(n_dev / n_val)),
  kg_sentence,
  sprintf("Against the device, sensitivity was %s and specificity %s, Youden's J %s.", cls_ci("se"), cls_ci("sp"), num(j_item)),
  freq_sentence, pase_sentence, weekly_sentence)

active <- more(bout) || more(counts)
freq_gain <- if (!j_rises) "did not consistently raise agreement" else if (max(j_cuts) < 0.3) "raised agreement only modestly" else "raised agreement"
weeks <- if (combination == "mean") "one or two weeks" else "one week"
conclusions <- paste(
  sprintf("%s, but the walking question separated device-defined walkers %s%s; requiring more frequent walking %s.",
          if (active) "Self-reported walkers were more active by accelerometry" else "Self-reported walkers were not clearly more active by accelerometry",
          separates, if (pase_like) ", as did the PASE walking items" else "", freq_gain),
  sprintf("The low agreement has two readings: the question may misclassify walking, or it may capture a long-term walking habit that %s of hip-worn activity counts, which do not single out walking, cannot reflect.", weeks))

# The brief's Figures 1-3, each uploaded as its own image; the captions say what each shows.
# PASE's any-walking point is a triangle (a definition in use) only at walker threshold 0, as in the brief
triangles <- if (assumption("pase.walker_threshold") == 0) "Triangles: any walking (in use), nearly coinciding at top right" else
  "Triangle: any walking on the question (in use)"
figures <- c(
  brief_fig1 = sprintf("Walker definitions by sensitivity and 1 − specificity against the device. %s; grey lines: equal Youden's J.", triangles),
  brief_fig2 = sprintf("Share who are device-defined walkers (95%% CI) by reported walking frequency: the question, and PASE at %s.", wave("06")),
  brief_fig3 = sprintf("Device minutes a week in bouts (median, interquartile range) by PASE-reported weekly walking, at %s.", at_visits))
captions <- stats::setNames(sprintf("Figure %d. %s", seq_along(figures), figures), sprintf("Figure %d caption", seq_along(figures)))
images <- length(figures)

fields <- c(Title = title, Purpose = purpose, Methods = methods, Results = results,
            Conclusions = conclusions, captions)
budget <- oaireport::char_budget(fields, images = images, per_image = per_image, limit = limit)

# The paste file: one block per field, each with its count, the images to upload, then the budget
dir.create("text", showWarnings = FALSE)
blocks <- unlist(lapply(names(fields), function(f) c(sprintf("%s (%s characters)", toupper(f), count(nchar(fields[[f]]))), fields[[f]], "")))
budget_lines <- paste(format(budget$part, width = 24), count(budget$characters))  # format() pads by characters
uploads <- sprintf("Figure %d: figures/%s.png", seq_along(figures), names(figures))
paste_file <- file(file.path("text", "abstract.txt"), open = "w", encoding = "UTF-8")
writeLines(c(blocks, "IMAGES TO UPLOAD", uploads, "", "CHARACTER BUDGET", budget_lines), paste_file)
close(paste_file)
```

```{r show}
#| results: asis
body <- c(Purpose = purpose, Methods = methods, Results = results, Conclusions = conclusions)
cat("## ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
for (f in names(body)) cat(sprintf("**%s.** %s\n\n", f, body[[f]]))
widths <- c(brief_fig1 = "55%", brief_fig2 = "100%", brief_fig3 = "100%")
for (i in seq_along(figures)) {
  cat(oaireport::figure_group(), sep = "\n")
  cat(figure_file(names(figures)[i], width = widths[[names(figures)[i]]]), sep = "\n")
  cat(oaireport::table_note(figures[[i]], label = sprintf("Figure %d", i), close_group = TRUE), sep = "\n")
}
```
